Eastplain has fertile land and produces plenty through farming and woodworking, but has little smelting capacity. Work schedules there also prioritize water services, farmland, medical care, and schools. The 16 sail barges on the river and public buses on shore will only run cross-district errands after an agreement is signed and fees are paid.
Eastplain's public warehouse has separate accounts and is not merged with Hearth City: {变量1} tools, {变量2} wood, {变量3} food in stock.
Epidemic-control medicine for levee work is tracked separately: {变量4} in stock; of that, {变量5} funded locally, {变量6} delivered by North Shore ships, and {变量7} used for routine levee maintenance. The minimum medicine stock reserved for local residents' routine care is never used.
If shared expenditure is paused, the local area will be left without support due to interrupted supplies. If levee integrity falls below 60, flooding will destroy stored food and force the docks to suspend sailings. Emergency local production can use only unscheduled treatment capacity for the current period and local stored food or waste; it cannot conjure finished medicine from nothing.
